GOOD TO KNOW

A little booking guide

Everything starts with a conversation about your event and the look you love.

How do I enquire?

Send your event date, event type and makeup inspiration through Instagram to begin your enquiry.

Which looks can I book?

Basic party, party & occasion, haldi, signature glam fix, engagement and bridal makeup are available.

Can I share inspiration?

Yes—send reference photos and discuss the look you have in mind during your enquiry.

Do you take outstation bookings?

Yes, bookings across India are welcome, subject to date availability and travel arrangements. Travel and accommodation costs, if needed, are quoted separately.

WHERE WE SERVE

At your doorstep, anywhere in India

At-home makeup appointments and outstation bookings nationwide, subject to availability and travel arrangements.
